title: Saturday plans
summary: Two friends decide between football and a film.

sentences.zh: 小丽，星期六你有时间吗？
sentences.en: Xiaoli, are you free on Saturday?
Yes. What do you want to do?

sentences.zh: 我们去踢足球还是去看电影？
sentences.en: Shall we play football or see a film?

sentences.zh: 听说星期六天气很好，我们去踢足球吧。
sentences.en: I heard the weather will be nice on Saturday; let's play football.

sentences.zh: 好啊！我跟我哥哥一起去，可以吗？
sentences.en: Great! Can my brother come with us?
Sure — more people is more fun.

sentences.zh: 踢完球，我们再去看电影，怎么样？
sentences.en: After football, let's see a film, how about that?

sentences.zh: 好。那我们几点在哪儿见？
sentences.en: OK. So what time and where shall we meet?

sentences.zh: 早上九点，在学校门口见。
sentences.en: Nine in the morning, at the school gate.

questions.prompt: What will they do first on Saturday?
why: Right: 我们去踢足球吧 — and the film comes after (踢完球…再去看电影).
Right: 我跟我哥哥一起去.
Xiaoming asks to bring his brother.
They go to the cinema later.
They meet at the school, not at home.
